freeze.speed_scope: Historical~8x isolated resident ionic core; current integrated benchmark not a qualified speedup.

quality.normalization: For each trajectory/channel S=max(max_t abs(I_reference),1e-7 mA/cm2). Charge errors divided by duration*S, not near-zero signed target charge. Report absolute errors and peak-relative charge diagnostics as well. No averaging across regimes to waive a failed critical gate.
quality.event_support: Transient timing evaluated only when reference peak-baseline contrast >=25% of S, peak >=10*floor, and peak is internal to the window. Other cases explicitly not_evaluable; amplitude/current gates still apply. Onset/offset use 10% of reference transient amplitude. Multi-event morphology needs dedicated matching in closed-loop stage.

native active reference vs canonical kinetic formula and same classical axial solve
execution: Native NEURON and CUDA evaluation isolated subprocesses. Modelseeds vectorized; cases/sites batched within topology. Graph/eager bitwise preflight; explicit eager fallback only for graph capture unavailable, never parity failure. No timing speedup qualification.
evaluation: Per-site original current/gate metrics including event support; native V/Ca floor with original compartment thresholds. Native-floor failure disables model judgment for affected cases, but preserves diagnostics.40ms interface panel is not a long-tail stress confirmation.

hypotheses.feedback: New failures in autonomous vs imposed paths indicate feedback amplification, not automatically missing local state.
hypotheses.coupling: Topology/coupling contrasts separate disconnected batching errors from true propagation effects.

backup: Persist native files after each topology, progress JSON and all frozen outputs. Notebook parent archives partial outputs on worker failure. Kaggle persisted ZIP recovered locally and SHA/CRC verified. DB complete backup local only. No intermediate backup claim without external readback.
